# EkLine docs — Automated documentation review and AI writing

AI-powered documentation for engineering teams. Create, update, and review docs with confidence.

[Docs Agent](/agent/) [Docs Reviewer](/reviewer/quickstart/)

## Choose your Product

[Section titled “Choose your Product”](#choose-your-product)

Docs Agent

Generate API docs, guides, and READMEs from your code using AI. Keep docs in sync as code changes.

[Get Started →](/agent)

Docs Reviewer

Automated quality assurance for your documentation. Catches style, grammar, and terminology issues in CI/CD.

[How it works →](/reviewer/overview/) · [Quickstart →](/reviewer/quickstart/)

## What EkLine catches

[Section titled “What EkLine catches”](#what-ekline-catches)

-   **Style violations** — Active voice, sentence length, readability
-   **Grammar issues** — Spelling, punctuation, syntax
-   **Terminology** — Enforce product names, technical terms
-   **Structural problems** — Heading hierarchy, link validity

## Integration guides

[Section titled “Integration guides”](#integration-guides)

GitHub Action

Checks run automatically on every PR.

[Set up GitHub Action →](/reviewer/quickstart/github-action/)

VS Code

Real-time feedback as you write.

[Set up VS Code →](/reviewer/quickstart/vscode/)

# EkLine docs — Automated documentation review and AI writing

AI-powered documentation for engineering teams. Create, update, and review docs with confidence.

[Docs Agent](/agent/) [Docs Reviewer](/reviewer/quickstart/)

## Choose your Product

[Section titled “Choose your Product”](#choose-your-product)

Docs Agent

Generate API docs, guides, and READMEs from your code using AI. Keep docs in sync as code changes.

[Get Started →](/agent)

Docs Reviewer

Automated quality assurance for your documentation. Catches style, grammar, and terminology issues in CI/CD.

[How it works →](/reviewer/overview/) · [Quickstart →](/reviewer/quickstart/)

## What EkLine catches

[Section titled “What EkLine catches”](#what-ekline-catches)

-   **Style violations** — Active voice, sentence length, readability
-   **Grammar issues** — Spelling, punctuation, syntax
-   **Terminology** — Enforce product names, technical terms
-   **Structural problems** — Heading hierarchy, link validity

## Integration guides

GitHub Action

Checks run automatically on every PR.

[Set up GitHub Action →](/reviewer/quickstart/github-action/)

Real-time feedback as you write.
